args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. We rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback is verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back to ~0.2%. Next step: investigate v2.3.1 regression (note v2.3.1-rc passed in staging but v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production) before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy in all regions after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified successfully.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed deploy, the rollback action, and current healthy state, with a follow-up note to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any re-deploy.
